## 2. The 7 flagged workflows (exact remediation)

| Workflow | Issue | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `masking-policy-lint.yml` | schedule without `workflow_dispatch` | add `workflow_dispatch:` to `on:` |
| `_dynamic-runner-template.yml` | schedule without `workflow_dispatch` | add `workflow_dispatch:` |
| `_dynamic-runner-template.yml` | multi-job, no `concurrency` group | add `concurrency: {group: …, cancel-in-progress: true}` |
| `pod-emission-audit.yml` | multi-job, no `concurrency` group | add concurrency group |
| `ci-tests.yml` | broad deploy-path glob (`**/*.json` etc.) | enumerate exact files in `paths:` filter |
| `deploy-competition-to-site.yml` | broad deploy-path glob | enumerate exact files |
| `audit-drift-telemetry.yml` | broad deploy-path glob | enumerate exact files |

---

## 3. Why these matter

- **Missing `workflow_dispatch`** on scheduled workflows means a failed cron run cannot be manually re-triggered → stuck jobs.
- **Missing `concurrency`** risks cancel-cascades (a recorded 2026-05 failure mode where queued runs out-paced drain).
- **Broad globs** (`**/*.json`, `audit_dashboard/**`) on push-triggered deploy workflows risk infinite loops when the workflow commits generated data.

---

## 4. How to apply

The framework (`gha-framework/qa-actions-audit.yml` + `audit_workflows.py`) is ready to install into `.github/workflows/` in the source repo. It will run weekly, on demand, and on workflow-file changes, and fail loudly if any workflow violates the rubric.
